4. Another visible snippet, from unfortunateeventsmovie.com, also claimed: 'directed by Barry Sonnenfeld.'
5. The agent extracted the name 'Barry Sonnenfeld' from these visible text snippets and reported it as the director without directly verifying other sources or considering the original query keyword ('Brad Silberling').
